title: Staging secret rotation certification matrix
evidenceRedaction: hashes, versions, identities and sanitized paths only; secretValuesIncluded must be false

steps.name: workload-obtains-credential
steps.proof: Keycloak client_credentials + scope=openbao.workload, then auth/jwt-codestra/cel/login returns exactly workload-<identity>-staging with TTL <= 300 s

steps.name: workload-functions-on-version-n
steps.proof: the agent-rendered file for version N exists with mode 0400, service uid/gid and the reviewed sha256; the service health verifier passes before rotation

steps.name: rotate-n-to-n-plus-1
steps.proof: bao kv put -cas=<N> writes version N+1 under the identity's own prefix only; the path is checked against workload-secret-authority.v1.json before the write

steps.name: agent-renders-n-plus-1
steps.proof: within 120 s the rendered file carries the expected sha256 of the N+1 payload with unchanged mode and ownership

steps.name: new-credential-verified
steps.proof: the read-only N+1 verifier succeeds against the consuming service (no provider or business effect)

steps.name: old-credential-revoked-and-denied
steps.proof: the old credential is revoked, then the old-credential verifier must fail; a still-succeeding old credential aborts the run with exit 2

steps.name: workload-re-authenticates-and-stays-healthy
steps.proof: the service health verifier passes after revocation; the identity certifier's token-revocation check proves a revoked OpenBao token is denied on the next read

steps.name: sanitized-evidence-recorded
steps.proof: evidence JSON (mode 0400) holds environment, identity, sanitized path, previous/current version, payload sha256 and PASS flags; secretValuesIncluded=false and providerBusinessEffectsEnabled=false are asserted
